kebab_example: aliyun pds list-domains --parent-domain-id bj1 --marker NWQ1Yjk4YmI1ZDRlYmU1Y2E0YWE0NmJhYWJmODBhNDQ2NzhlMTRhMg --limit 60 --service-code pds --api-version 2022-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDomains

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent domain
parameters.name: parent_domain_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of marker
parameters.help_zh: 分页 marker，"" 表示从头开始。该接口会返回 next_marker，可将 next_marker 设置该值来遍历所有 domain 信息
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 本次分页获取的数量，默认 50，不可超过 100
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
Service code. Default is pds.

edm (Enterprise Edition)

pds (Developer Edition)
parameters.help_zh:
服务代码，默认为pds

edm（企业版）
pds（开发版）
parameters.name: service_code
